data.description: Next to Lagoon | Prime Location | Motivated Seller
data.long_description:
Discover an exceptional opportunity to own a beautifully designed 4-bedroom townhouse in Bora Bora 1, DAMAC Islands. Inspired by tropical island living, this contemporary home offers spacious interiors, elegant finishes, and a thoughtfully planned layout that perfectly balances comfort, style, and functionality for modern family living.

Located within the exclusive DAMAC Islands community, residents enjoy access to world-class amenities, including crystal-inspired lagoons, landscaped parks, fitness facilities, swimming pools, children's play areas, and a vibrant waterfront lifestyle. 

With excellent connectivity to major road networks and key destinations across Dubai, this property presents an outstanding opportunity for both end-users and investors seeking luxury island-inspired living.
